tasks.title: HANGS Construction Services · 2026 Form 940
tasks.description: Prepare the 2026 Form 940, the federal unemployment (FUTA) return, for HANGS Construction Services from 10 Excel, PDF, Word and email documents. Work out each employee’s first $7,000 of FUTA wages quarter by quarter, the exempt Section 125 premiums, the 0.6% tax after the state credit, each quarter’s liability and which quarters needed a deposit, with the fourth quarter projected. Produce formula-linked Excel workpapers and supported figures on an incomplete draft return. Open items stay open for a person. This demo plays back one recorded run; the run’s real working time is shown at the end.
tasks.outputs: Two files: formula-linked Excel workpapers with evidence tabs, and an incomplete draft Form 940 PDF with evidence trails and original source attachments
tasks.gates: Incomplete draft, not reviewed, signed or filed. The fourth quarter is projected. Missing evidence and differences stay open. A person reviews and files.
tasks.periodLine: Calendar year 2026 · Form 940, federal unemployment (FUTA) tax · due February 1, 2027 · fourth quarter projected.
